d: Jharkhand ki uprajdhani dumka men lok aastha ke mahaparv chhath ko lekar taiyariyan jor-shor se chal rahi hain. kahin ghaton ki saphaee ho rahi hai, to kahin rangaee-putaee aur aakarshak sajavat ka kam antim rup le raha hai. shahar ke khunta bandh chhath ghat par vratiyon aur shraddhaluon ki suvidha evan suraksha ko lekar chhath puja samiti aur sthaniy karigar din-rat jute hue hain. is bich dumka disi abhijit sinha, espi pitanbar sinh khervar aur esdiem kaushal kumar ne khunta bandh, bara bandh aur rasikpur talab ka nirikshan kiya. adhikariyon ne ghaton ki taiyariyon ka jayja lete hue…
